entities.name: Razor Fields
entities.description: A dangerous region that leonin clerics must survive for one turning of the suns.

entities.name: Cave of Light
entities.description: A place where only leonin clerics who survived the Razor Fields may stand.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane through whose surface the red sun burst to take its place in the heavens.

entities.name: Vulshok
entities.description: A people of Mirrodin whose mana rituals echo the day the red sun emerged.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A realm where the undead are fueled by hatred of the living and life's circle has become inverted.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: A land whose main crops are rot, slime, and despair.

entities.name: Rannon
entities.description: A Vithian holdout.

entities.name: Desmera
entities.description: The perfect of Wren's Run.

entities.name: Wren's Run
entities.description: A place whose perfect is Desmera.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A speaker who declares that others will learn to earn death.

entities.name: Skirk Ridge
entities.description: A ridge where craghorn skeletons lie tangled in each other's horns.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and mind mage who comments on Chandra Nalaar's mind.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker whose mind is described as an incredible mix of emotion and power.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A realm ruled by dragon lords through edicts of flame.

entities.name: Hadran
entities.description: A sunseeder of Naya.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A realm that is home to Hadran.

entities.name: Lord Hilneth
entities.description: A military leader who fears only the morning fog.

entities.name: Kamahl, Fist of Krosa
entities.description: A warrior whose mind has changed but whose strength has not.

entities.name: Eidren
entities.description: The perfect of Lys Alana who had trees rearranged to create the Gilt-Leaf Wood.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: A place whose perfect is Eidren.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf Wood
entities.description: A forest created when Eidren had hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged.

entities.name: Molimo, Maro-Sorcerer
entities.description: A spirit of the forest who declares himself deathless Llanowar.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: A forest embodied by Molimo.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A powerful being whose shadow takes on a cruel life of its own; his name marks signets.

entities.name: Rakka Mar
entities.description: A speaker who believes lightning lives in everything and must be set free.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who warns never to corner a barbarian.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: A leader whose people Gerrard helped save from a Phyrexian fate.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: A hero who helped save Eladamri's people from a Phyrexian fate.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: A threatening force from whose fate Eladamri's people were saved.

entities.name: Kaervek the Merciless
entities.description: A figure so dreadful that even rats and jackals will not walk with him.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: A speaker who comments on Kaervek.

entities.name: Trigori
entities.description: An Azorius senator.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: A guild whose law is strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A guild that follows nature's example of mindless destruction.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: A secret guild whose insignia is seen only by its members and the doomed.

entities.name: Taani
entities.description: A berserker of Etlan.

entities.name: Etlan
entities.description: The home of the berserker Taani.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A place where the wolves watch the flock.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings whose warped minds alone can open the hedrons.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A Tazeem lullmage.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: The home of the lullmage Noyan Dar.

entities.name: Æther
entities.description: The flow of spellcraft that the Lodestone Golem warps.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A being who found madness in the blur between metal and flesh.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A realm described as austere, unyielding, and inscrutable.

entities.name: Simun the Quiet
entities.description: A figure who filled a chest with his precious thoughts and locked away the memory of the key's hiding place.

entities.name: Pontifex
entities.description: An elder researcher who commands obedient constructs.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The maker of the metathran, conceived by an integrated system of machines.

entities.name: Metathran
entities.description: Urza's children, conceived, birthed, and nurtured by machines.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
entities.description: A city-tree whose seeds become children in service to the Conclave.

entities.name: Conclave
entities.description: The group served by the children of Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Etherium
entities.description: A dwindling material that mechanists send gargoyles to salvage.

events.summary: In the past, the red sun burst through Mirrodin's surface to take its place in the heavens.
events.quote: Vulshok mana rituals echo the day when the red sun burst through Mirrodin's surface to take its place in the heavens.

events.summary: Eidren ordered hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged, creating the Gilt-Leaf Wood.
events.quote: Thus the Gilt-Leaf Wood was born.

events.summary: Eladamri returns the favor to Gerrard, who had helped save his people from the Phyrexians.
events.quote: You helped save my people from a Phyrexian fate. Did you think I wouldn't return the favor?

events.summary: Simun the Quiet locked his thoughts in a chest and, in paranoia, locked away the memory of the key's location.
events.quote: But in a fit of paranoia, he locked up the memory of where he hid the key.
